lean_consumer_control.interpretation: Excluded local capability diagnostic with common benchmark-module-images support; compiler dependencies remain. Process endpoints are not live heap or peak RSS.

join_pc_profile.interpretation: Unscored user self-PC samples over 100 complete Store lifecycles, including startup/GC and capture overhead; not execution-only/inclusive time, allocation counts or live heap. Inert PC CSVs, owner ranges and exact symbol inventories support offline attribution without exporting ELFs.
